title: Naturally Smoky Yucatecan Pickles Horchata
description: A unique and refreshing horchata featuring smoky dill pickles, perfect for a date night with a Mexican twist
instructions: Combine the rice, water, and cinnamon sticks in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender
Strain the rice mixture through a cheesecloth into a large bowl, discarding the solids
Add the chopped dill pickles, smoked paprika, vanilla extract, dates, and lime juice to the bowl and stir to combine
Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld
Stir the horchata well before serving and serve cold
Garnish with additional chopped dill pickles and a sprinkle of smoked paprika, if desired
